title: Vending machine quote checklist for Malaysian buyers
excerpt: Prepare one brief for suppliers and compare machine fit, payment fees, installation, software and warranty on the same basis.
opening: Two machines can hold similar products and still cost different amounts to install and run. Ask each supplier to quote the same products and site, then put one-off charges and ongoing charges in separate columns. Request a demonstration with your actual packaging if you sell unusually tall bottles, light packs or fragile items.
checklist_title: What to send and what to ask
checklist: Send your postcode, location status, floor photos and the measured delivery route. State whether you need help finding a site.
List your likely products, pack measurements and required storage conditions. Ask for the layout and usable capacity with that mix.
List the payment methods you need. Separate hardware cost, transaction fees and settlement timing. Ask who handles failed payments and refunds.
Request an itemised quote for the machine, installation, delivery, training, connectivity, software and any upgrades. Ask whether prices include applicable taxes.
Get the warranty in writing. Distinguish parts, labour, travel and exclusions. Ask how service requests are handled at your postcode.
Agree what acceptance looks like. At handover, verify the selected products vend, a payment completes, the sale appears in reporting and your team can refill the machine.
close: Send the same brief to each supplier. Compare the cash due before opening and the estimated cost over the same operating period, using the same sales assumptions.
